youtube.baslik: Why do children struggle more in noise than adults? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The signal-to-noise ratio is the difference between the speech level and the noise level. Children still learning language cannot fill in missing sounds, so a ratio of at least plus 15 dB at the ear is recommended in classrooms.

sahneler.metin: Why do children struggle *more* in noise?
cumleler: Why do children struggle more in noise than adults?
The signal-to-noise ratio is the speech level minus the noise level.
Speech at sixty five, noise at fifty five decibels: plus ten.
Adults easily fill in missing sounds using language and context.
Children still learning language cannot; they need a better ratio.
At least plus fifteen decibels at the ear is recommended in class.
